items.title: GitHub - rudderlabs/devbox: Open source autonomous engineering harness in your cloud. One sandbox per task, no real secrets inside.
items.summary: Hand DevBox a ticket. It plans the change, writes the code, runs the tests, reviews its own work and opens a draft pull request. You review and merge.
